title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani hides from Anbu at the hospital and gets emotional seeing her baby during the scan. Anbu gets a glimpse of his child when the nurse accidentally drops her scan report.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Viji Gets a Lead on Her Missing Son
description: Viji and Ilamathi find a vital clue regarding her missing son through his silver chain marked 'A'. Kalamma is stunned as the discovery may bring them closer to the truth.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya finally gets a job at a supermarket after a long search to overcome financial troubles. Shanmugam praises Sarala for managing the household and supporting him.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Pechi faces Azhagar's accusations over his parents' plight and breaks down before Mayandi and Meenatchi. She pleads with Poongodi not to act against Mayandi's family.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Cheran Invites Families to the Wedding
description: Chozhan, Nila, and Cheran visit Kasturi's, Vannathi's, and Nila's families to give Cheran's wedding invitations. Meanwhile, Cheran feels sad about Karthika's life.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj remains firm on divorce, ignoring Rohini's affectionate words and efforts to win him back. Sathya defends Sinthamani's actions despite her humiliation of Chandra.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi struggles to arrange the money within two days without support. Eshwari pressures Aishwarya to sneak the tender amount from Sethupathi's file to help Neethimaan.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Kasthuri eats from Karthik's plate, prompting Swetha to demand Arjun's. At the jewellery shop, Karikalan's mother panics over a missing handbag and accuses the Kerala girl.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira explains QR payments to Kandhasamy, who agrees to use them. Later, Kandhasamy speaks highly of Indhira while discussing her request with Ganesan.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: Angels vs Demons Showdown
description: Angels and Demons go head-to-head in extreme patience tasks. Mind games, role swaps, and emotional clashes rock the house before a shocking result.
